title: Lynx: The Dual-Purpose JavaScript API Client and HTTP Server
excerpt: Discover Lynx, an open-source JavaScript repository that functions as both a robust API client and a lightweight HTTP server. Learn how this unified interface simplifies HTTP operations for developers, backed by industry trends showing rising API tool usage and JavaScript's dominance in API development.
